name: Simeon
summary: Jacob's second son, born to Leah. With his brother Levi he took violent revenge on the city of Shechem, and later Joseph held him as a prisoner in Egypt.

key_moments.title: Born to Leah
key_moments.description: Leah named her second son Simeon, saying the LORD had heard that she was unloved.

key_moments.title: Revenge for Dinah
key_moments.description: After Shechem had defiled their sister Dinah, Simeon and Levi took their swords and killed the men of the city. Jacob told them they had brought trouble on him.

key_moments.title: Held in Egypt
key_moments.description: Joseph took Simeon and bound him before his brothers' eyes, sending the others home to bring Benjamin. When they came back, Simeon was brought out to them.

key_moments.title: Jacob's Last Words
key_moments.description: Jacob said Simeon and Levi were brothers who used weapons of cruelty. He cursed their fierce anger and said they would be scattered in Israel.
